name: test_duplicate_scenario_blocks_disallowed_application_before_save[active-exclusivity]
description:
Objective: Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
Preconditions: Open Add Application duplicate checks with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Add Application duplicate checks.
2. Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The intake fixes Status to the rejection; it cannot be saved as a New Application.
descriptionHtml:
Objective: Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
Preconditions: Open Add Application duplicate checks with the configured test data.
Steps:

  1. Open Add Application duplicate checks.
  2. Duplicate scenario blocks disallowed application before save.
  3. Observe the resulting state.
    Expected: The intake fixes Status to the rejection; it cannot be saved as a New Application.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: duplicate-search 'aaaaa': HTTP 502 {'timestamp': '2026-11-03T05:06:03.311078942Z', 'resultInfo': {'codeId': '5183', 'code': 'KESEF_INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE', 'message': 'The KESEF integration is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.', 'status': 'F'}}
assert 502 == 200
statusTrace:
tests/e2e/application/test_application_duplicates.py:317: in test_duplicate_scenario_blocks_disallowed_application_before_save
    applications, broker, data = _open_discovered_case(page, scenario)
                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
tests/e2e/application/test_application_duplicates.py:250: in _open_discovered_case
    searched = _duplicate_searches(page, names, scenario.application_type)
               ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
tests/e2e/application/test_application_duplicates.py:117: in _duplicate_searches
    assert result["status"] == 200, f"duplicate-search {name!r}: HTTP {result['status']} {result['payload']!r}"
E   AssertionError: duplicate-search 'aaaaa': HTTP 502 {'timestamp': '2026-11-03T05:06:03.311078942Z', 'resultInfo': {'codeId': '5183', 'code': 'KESEF_INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE', 'message': 'The KESEF integration is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.', 'status': 'F'}}
E   assert 502 == 200
